about: The sample DOORS history of the Apollo example: each run is one export, made from specs/ with every earlier run's edits applied. demo.write_sample_exports writes them out. Release 1 covers standard (H) missions; Release 2 adds extended (J) missions.

runs.about: Release 2: extended missions, with more propellant, batteries, oxygen and water, and a longer stay

edits.append:
.. requirement:: MSN-012
   :verification: Analysis

   The mission system shall fly extended missions, with a planned surface stay of 75 hours.

.. requirement:: LM-PRP-004
   :satisfies: MSN-012
   :subsystem: PRP
   :verification: Inspection
   :last-modified-by: jdoe

   The extended lunar module shall carry 9,000 kg of descent propellant.

.. requirement:: LM-EPS-003
   :satisfies: MSN-012
   :subsystem: EPS
   :verification: Inspection
   :last-modified-by: jdoe

   The extended lunar module shall carry five descent batteries of 415 Ah each.

.. requirement:: LM-ECS-003
   :satisfies: MSN-012
   :subsystem: ECS
   :verification: Inspection
   :last-modified-by: jdoe

   The extended lunar module shall carry 44 kg of oxygen and 300 kg of water in its descent stage.

.. requirement:: LGC-CFG-002
   :satisfies: MSN-012
   :subsystem: CFG
   :verification: Test
   :last-modified-by: jdoe

   The LGC shall accept an erasable load for an extended mission, and fly the descent with that mission's numbers.

.. requirement:: LGC-PRP-002
   :satisfies: MSN-003, LM-PRP-004
   :subsystem: PRP
   :verification: Test
   :last-modified-by: jdoe

   N93 shall show the descent propellant remaining as a percentage of the propellant the erasable load says was loaded.
